context: Runbook: database failover
text: If the primary database becomes unavailable, first confirm the outage from the monitoring dashboard. Then promote the read replica using the failover script and update the connection string in the configuration service.

This PR adds retry handling for failed payment webhooks. Previously a single network error would mark the payment as failed. Now we retry up to three times with exponential backoff before giving up and alerting the on-call engineer.

Fixes a crash when the user opens the settings screen without an active subscription. The view model assumed the plan object was always present, so I added a fallback state and a test that covers the empty case.
